children: Telecom Italia said top executives tendered their shares into Poste Italiane's voluntary public tender offer.
The Italian telecommunications company on Monday said Chief Executive Officer Pietro Labriola and other key managers have contributed their entire equity holdings to the offer.
In July, TIM's board said it viewed the bid--which is valued at more than 13 billion euros ($15.10 billion)--from its biggest shareholder as favorable and deemed the price to be fair.

Under the bid, Poste Italiane offered 1.67 euros in cash and 0.218 newly issued Poste ordinary shares for each TIM share tendered. The Telecom Italia board's acceptance of the bid was finalized last week.
